name: The Stairwell
narrator_line: Stairwell Threshold. Concrete stairwell. Marking: FLOOR 2. This marking is correct.

map.layout: A plain concrete stairwell behind the stage, spiral steps down into the dark, a handwritten card taped to the rail.
map.hazards: None; the choice is the hazard.

encounters.our_name: The Stairwell Threshold: Descend Now or Wait

voice_lines.intro: Stairwell Threshold. Concrete stairwell. Marking: FLOOR 2. This marking is correct.
voice_lines.twist: STASIS WARNING displayed over the first step. Descent with more than six hours remaining triggers stasis until collapse.
voice_lines.win: Descent recorded for departing Crawlers. Remaining Crawlers continue on-floor. Status updated.
